card.name: Start of hypo- and other medical word stems
card.fires_on: The piece 'hypo' (and similar word starts such as 'polym', 'lymphocyt', 'bacteri', 'NEUTROP') partway into a medical term, where an ending like -osmotic, -albuminemia or -ia follows.

modes.label: hypo- in lists
modes.description: The prefix hypo- opens a term, often in hypo- or hyper- pairs, in fluid and glucose warnings.
modes.example: intravenous administration of glucose can cause electrolyte disturbances, most importantly<< hypo>>- or hyperosmotic hypon

modes.label: Other medical word stems
modes.description: Partway through a long condition or science word that still needs an ending.
modes.example: B-cell lymphocyt<<open>>ia in infants exposed to rituxim

card.writes: It pushes word endings such as -istically, -onic, -nic and -ativ, which finish technical words.
card.plain: It fires inside long medical words, especially after 'hypo', when the word still needs its ending.
